'''XT987''' was an uninhabited [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. [[Ferus Olin]] and resistance leaders part of [[Moonstrike (Acherin)|Moonstrike]] stopped here on their way to [[Jedi asteroid|Ferus' base]] when it was discovered that [[Eve Yarrow]], known as Flame, was an Imperial spy.
